title: 第二十三章古道藏忠骨剑下祭英魂第二十四章 秘事终大白恩仇一念间
content_zh:
梅岭的风，吹了十二年，依旧带着未散的硝烟与忠魂的呜咽。那片被烈火焚烧过的山谷，乱石嶙峋间，每一寸泥土都浸染着赤焰军的热血，每一缕风都诉说着十二年前的惊天冤案。在这场冤案的余波里，有一位皇子，褪去了金殿的繁华，背负着血海深仇与家国期许，在落寞的古道上独行，以剑为誓，以心为炬，用十二年的隐忍与坚守，劈开了一条通往正义的道路，用一生的赤诚与担当，祭奠了七万英魂的冤屈。他，便是萧琰，大梁七皇子，后来的武靖帝，一个生于宫墙却不染权谋浊气，身陷泥泞却始终心向光明的忠义之人。
萧琰的少年时光，是在金陵城的暖阳与梅岭的长风里度过的。彼时的他，尚是未经世事的七皇子，母亲静妃出身林府医女，性情温婉隐忍，给予了他最纯粹的教养；他自幼在皇长兄祁王萧景禹身边长大，深受祁王贤明风骨的熏陶，心中早早埋下了正义与担当的种子。而他生命中最耀眼的光，来自于他的表弟兼挚友——赤焰军少帅林殊。那时的林殊，是金陵城最明媚的少年，鲜衣怒马，武艺高强，眉宇间尽是少年意气；萧琰则英武挺拔，性子执拗纯粹，两人朝夕相伴，一同在演武场练剑，一同在书斋共读，一同许下“策马扬鞭，守护大梁河山”的誓言。
少年的情谊，纯粹而炽热；少年的理想，坦荡而坚定。那时的萧琰，早已在军旅中崭露头角，他承袭了林燮将军的刚毅之气，又有着皇子的沉稳气度，在赤焰军中威望渐长，与林殊并肩作战，所向披靡。他记得，林殊曾拍着他的肩膀说：“景琰，将来我守边关，你辅明君，咱们一起让大梁国泰民安，再也没有战乱流离。”他也记得，自己曾郑重承诺，定会护林殊周全，护赤焰军周全，护这大梁的万里河山周全。那时的他们，以为前路坦荡，以为誓言可期，却不知一场精心策划的阴谋，早已在暗处悄然酝酿，即将将这所有的美好，尽数撕碎。
十二年前，赤焰军奉命出征梅岭，抵御大渝皇属军的入侵。七万赤焰儿郎，皆是忠勇之士，在林燮将军的带领下，浴血奋战，虽伤亡惨重，却终将敌军击溃。可就在他们以为可以凯旋之际，谢玉与夏江却带着西境十万大军赶到，以仿冒的聂锋求救信为借口，污蔑祁王谋反、赤焰军附逆。梁帝萧选本就忌惮祁王的威望与赤焰军的实力，又在谢玉、夏江的谗言蛊惑下，一道圣旨，将七万赤焰忠良尽数屠戮于梅岭。烈火焚尽了营帐，鲜血染红了溪流，昔日所向披靡的赤焰军，沦为了“谋逆”的乱臣贼子；昔日温润贤明的祁王，被赐死宫中，祁王府、赤焰帅府尽数抄没。
彼时的萧琰，正奉旨出使东海，临行前，他还答应林殊，要为他带回鸽子蛋大的珍珠。可当他归来时，金陵城早已物是人非，昔日的挚友音信全无，敬重的长兄含冤而死，忠心的将士们背负着千古骂名，埋骨梅岭荒野。那一刻，萧琰的世界彻底崩塌了。他不信，不信那个心怀家国的长兄会谋反，不信那些与他并肩作战的赤焰儿郎会附逆，更不信他最信任的父皇，会如此狠心，屠戮忠良。
朝堂之上，满朝文武皆避之不及，无人敢为祁王与赤焰军说一句公道话，唯有萧琰，不顾梁帝的震怒与冷落，屡次直言进谏，为冤死者鸣不平。他跪在金殿之上，字字铿锵，力证祁王与赤焰军的清白，哪怕梁帝龙颜大怒，将他贬斥，哪怕百官非议，视他为异类，他也从未动摇。“臣弟愿以性命担保，祁王兄与林帅忠心耿耿，赤焰军个个忠勇，绝无谋逆之事！”这句话，他说了无数次，每一次，都带着撕心裂肺的痛，每一次，都彰显着他的执拗与赤诚。
可皇权至上，猜忌心重的梁帝，终究不会相信他的辩解。此后，萧琰便成了朝堂上的边缘人，一个被放逐的皇子。他虽战功累累，平定边境战乱，安抚一方百姓，却始终得不到应有的封赏，甚至连面见梁帝的机会都寥寥无几。太子与誉王皆想拉拢这位手握兵权、在军中颇有威望的皇子，许以高官厚禄，可萧琰不屑一顾。他厌恶朝堂上的尔虞我诈，厌恶那些为了权力不择手段的小人，更不愿与构陷赤焰忠良的奸佞同流合污。
十二年间，萧琰奉旨四处征战，远离金陵的权力中心，奔波于边关古道之上。那些古道，有的荒草丛生，人迹罕至；有的烽火连天，硝烟弥漫。他曾在漫天风雪中驻守边关，抵御外敌入侵；曾在泥泞的古道上跋涉，安抚流离失所的百姓；曾在深夜的营帐中，对着林殊的旧剑，诉说着无尽的思念与不甘。他始终佩戴着一枚赤焰军制的玉佩，那是林殊当年送他的礼物，也是他对赤焰忠魂的念想；他始终将林殊的旧剑放在身边，不许旁人触碰，那把剑，承载着他们少年时的誓言，也承载着七万赤焰军的冤屈。
有人说他愚蠢，放着皇子的尊荣不顾，非要为一群“谋逆”之人奔波；有人说他执拗，明知前路艰难，却依旧一条路走到黑；可只有萧琰自己知道，他坚守的，从来不是一句虚无的誓言，而是心中的正义，是对挚友的情谊，是对忠良的敬重，是对家国的担当。他知道，只要他不放弃，只要他还在坚持，总有一天，真相会大白于天下，总有一天，七万赤焰忠魂能够得以昭雪，总有一天，大梁的朝堂，能够重归清明。
十二年来，他忍受着孤独与痛苦，忍受着误解与排挤，在落寞的古道上独行，在铁血的战场上磨砺。他的棱角，未曾被岁月磨平；他的赤诚，未曾被权力腐蚀。他依旧是那个正直执拗、重情重义的萧琰，只是眉宇间，多了几分沧桑与坚毅，多了几分隐忍与担当。他在边关积攒实力，体恤将士，安抚百姓，收获了底层军民的拥戴，也培养了一批忠心耿耿的部下。这些年的蛰伏，不是退缩，不是妥协，而是为了等待一个机会，一个为赤焰军昭雪、为家国除奸的机会。
终于，那个机会来了。十二年后，一位化名梅长苏的谋士，拖着病弱之躯，来到了金陵城。他以“麒麟才子”之名，搅动金陵风云，看似周旋于太子与誉王之间，实则早已选定了萧琰，决意辅佐他登上帝位，为赤焰军昭雪沉冤。当梅长苏第一次出现在萧琰面前时，萧琰并未认出他的身份，只觉得这位谋士温文尔雅，却又心思缜密，手段凌厉，与自己厌恶的权谋之士并无二致。
起初，萧琰对梅长苏充满了戒备与误解。他反感梅长苏使用权谋手段，厌恶他周旋于权力漩涡之中，甚至在霓凰郡主被越贵妃陷害时，怒而斥责梅长苏，不许他挑战自己的底线，不许他用权谋陷害忠良。他告诉梅长苏：“我萧景琰所求，从来不是皇位，而是为祁王兄与赤焰军平反，是为天下百姓谋福祉。若你只是为了权力，为了利益，那我们道不同不相为谋。”
梅长苏从未辩解，只是默默陪伴在萧琰身边，为他出谋划策，为他扫清夺嫡路上的障碍。侵地案中，梅长苏为他谋划，助他在朝堂上崭露头角，引起太子与誉王的警惕；庭生被囚时，梅长苏巧施妙计，助他救出祁王遗腹子，了却了他多年的心愿；九安山之变时，梅长苏助他拿到兵符，平定誉王叛党，而萧琰在平定叛乱后，第一时间将兵符交还梁帝，那份坦荡与正直，让梁帝都为之迟疑。
在一次次的相处中，萧琰渐渐发现，梅长苏身上，有太多熟悉的痕迹。他思考时搓手指、捻衣袖的小动作，他对赤焰军的关切，他对金陵旧事的熟知，都让萧琰不由自主地想起当年的林殊。可他不敢相信，那个病弱不堪、手无缚鸡之力的谋士，会是当年那个鲜衣怒马、武艺高强的赤焰少帅。他害怕自己的猜测是真的，害怕林殊这些年所受的苦难，更害怕自己会因为个人情感，影响到昭雪冤案的大业。
卫峥事件，成为了两人关系的转折点，也是萧琰心境的转折点。夏江利用萧琰对赤焰旧部的牵挂，设下圈套，劫走卫峥，引诱萧琰冲动行事，妄图将他彻底扳倒。萧琰得知卫峥被劫后，果然怒不可遏，误以为梅长苏为了夺嫡大业，不惜牺牲赤焰旧部，他一剑斩断了代表彼此信任的宫铃，怒斥梅长苏“没有天性和良知”，全然不顾重病在身的梅长苏的哀求。那一刻，萧琰的心痛，不仅仅是因为误解，更是因为他害怕，自己坚守了十二年的信念，会被权谋彻底击碎。
直到真相渐渐浮出水面，萧琰才终于得知，眼前这个病弱的谋士，正是他思念了十二年的挚友林殊。当蒙挚将梅长苏的真实身份告知他时，这个铮铮铁骨的汉子，再也无法抑制心中的情感，回到芷萝宫，跪倒在静妃膝下，失声痛哭：“母亲，我就快认出他了，我应该认出他来的……他是小殊，他是我的小殊啊……”
那一刻，所有的误解与猜疑，所有的孤独与痛苦，都化作了泪水。他终于明白，梅长苏这些年所承受的，比他更多；梅长苏所背负的，比他更重。梅长苏以病弱之躯，背负着七万赤焰军的冤屈，周旋于权力的漩涡之中，步步为营，只为给忠魂昭雪，只为辅佐他登上皇位，只为实现他们少年时的誓言。而自己，却一次次误解他，伤害他，甚至差点毁了所有的希望。
得知真相后的萧琰，没有沉溺于悲伤与愧疚，而是将所有的情感，都化作了前行的力量。他不再排斥权谋，不再一味执拗，而是学会了隐忍与变通，学会了在权谋的漩涡中坚守底线，学会了与梅长苏并肩作战，共同推进昭雪大业。他知道，唯有登上皇位，唯有掌握权力，才能真正为赤焰军昭雪，才能真正铲除奸佞，才能真正实现他们少年时的理想。
此后，萧琰与梅长苏紧密筹划，步步为营。他们联合言阙、蒙挚、霓凰等忠义之士，搜集谢玉、夏江构陷赤焰军的证据；他们利用太子与誉王的矛盾，坐收渔利，逐渐壮大自己的势力；他们在朝堂上明争暗斗，一次次挫败奸佞的阴谋，一点点动摇梁帝的统治。萧琰不再是那个只会直言进谏的执拗皇子，他变得沉稳、睿智、有担当，他既能在战场上运筹帷幄，决胜千里，也能在朝堂上审时度势，步步为营。
梁帝寿宴之上，莅阳长公主携谢玉的手书供罪，当众揭开了赤焰冤案的一角。那一刻，朝堂震动，百官哗然。萧琰挺身而出，呈上所有证据，力证祁王与赤焰军的清白，字字泣血，句句铿锵。他与梁帝展开了激烈的对峙，质问梁帝为何要屠戮忠良，为何要背弃家国百姓，为何要让七万赤焰忠魂含冤九泉。

“父皇，十二年前，梅岭之上，七万赤焰儿郎浴血奋战，为大梁守住了边关，可他们换来的，却是乱箭穿心，烈火焚身；祁王兄贤明能干，心怀家国，可他换来的，却是一杯毒酒，满门抄斩。这十二年来，儿臣走遍边关古道，见过太多流离失所的百姓，见过太多赤焰旧部的冤屈，儿臣心中，唯有一个心愿，就是为他们昭雪，为他们讨回公道！”
梁帝的震怒，终究抵不过铁证如山，抵不过民心所向，抵不过萧琰的执着与坚守。最终，梁帝被迫下旨，重审赤焰旧案，为祁王、林燮及七万赤焰军昭雪沉冤。谢玉、夏江等奸佞之徒，终被绳之以法，得到了应有的惩罚。当圣旨宣读的那一刻，梅岭的风，仿佛都变得温柔了；金陵城的暖阳，仿佛都变得明媚了。十二年的隐忍与坚守，十二年的孤独与痛苦，终于换来了正义的降临，换来了忠魂的安息。
不久之后，梁帝禅位，萧琰登基为帝，改元武靖，史称武靖帝。登基后的萧琰，没有沉溺于皇位的尊荣，而是践行了自己的誓言，致力于整顿朝纲，安抚百姓，重振大梁河山。他重用言阙、沈追、蔡荃等贤良之士，整顿吏治，严惩贪腐；他推行仁政，减免赋税，安抚流离失所的百姓，让大梁的国力日渐强盛；他进行军事改革，裁汰老弱，重编北境军为长林军，任用卫峥训练水军，让大梁的边防更加稳固。
他始终没有忘记梅岭的七万忠魂，没有忘记那些为了正义而牺牲的人。他亲自前往梅岭，祭奠赤焰军将士，在古道之上，立碑铭文，铭记他们的忠勇与冤屈；他追封祁王为景恒帝，追封林燮为忠武王，追封所有赤焰军将士为忠勇侯，让他们的忠名，永载史册。他常常独自一人，来到梅岭的古道上，抚摸着石碑，仿佛还能看到当年赤焰军浴血奋战的身影，仿佛还能听到林殊少年时的笑声。
梅长苏终究没能陪他走到最后，在平定北境战乱后，梅长苏拖着病弱之躯，重返梅岭，最终病逝于当年赤焰军浴血奋战的地方，完成了他的使命，也践行了他与萧琰的誓言。萧琰得知消息后，悲痛欲绝，却没有沉溺于悲伤，他知道，他不能倒下，他要带着梅长苏的心愿，带着七万赤焰忠魂的期许，好好守护这大梁的万里河山，好好治理这天下，让百姓安居乐业，让再也没有冤屈与战乱。
萧琰的一生，是坎坷的一生，是隐忍的一生，更是忠义的一生。他生于宫墙，却不染权谋浊气；身陷泥泞，却始终心向光明；背负血海深仇，却始终坚守底线。他在落寞的古道上独行十二年，以剑为誓，以心为炬，劈开了一条通往正义的道路；他在权力的漩涡中坚守初心，以忠为魂，以义为骨，祭奠了七万赤焰忠魂的冤屈。
古道藏忠骨，那是七万赤焰军的忠魂，是祁王的忠魂，是所有为正义而牺牲的人的忠魂；剑下祭英魂，那是萧琰以一生的坚守与担当，为忠魂昭雪，为家国护航。萧琰用自己的一生，诠释了什么是忠义，什么是担当，什么是赤子之心。他的故事，如同梅岭的风，穿越千年，依旧在古道上回荡；他的忠义，如同不朽的丰碑，矗立在大梁的山河之间，永垂不朽。
多年以后，有人漫步在梅岭的古道上，看着那座刻满忠名的石碑，听着老人讲述着当年的故事，总会想起那个英武挺拔、执拗赤诚的皇子，想起他以剑祭英魂、以心守家国的一生。萧琰的名字，早已与赤焰忠魂、与大梁河山融为一体，成为了千古流传的忠义传奇，永远被世人铭记。

content_en:
The wind in Meiling has been blowing for twelve years, but it still carries the lingering smoke of gunpowder and the whimpering of loyal souls. In that valley burned by the fire, among the jagged rocks, every inch of soil was soaked with the blood of the Red Flame Army, and every wisp of wind told the story of the shocking injustice twelve years ago. In the aftermath of this unjust case, there was a prince who faded away from the prosperity of the Golden Palace. Carrying the blood feud and the expectations of his family and country, he walked alone on the lonely ancient road, using his sword as an oath and his heart as a torch. With twelve years of forbearance and perseverance, he opened a path to justice. With a lifetime of sincerity and responsibility, he paid tribute to the injustice of 70,000 heroic souls. He was Xiao Yan, the seventh prince of Liang Dynasty, and later Emperor Wu Jing. He was a loyal man who was born in a palace but was not tainted by the turmoil of intrigue. He was trapped in the mud but always had a bright heart.
Xiao Yan's youth was spent in the warm sunshine of Jinling City and the long wind of Meiling. At that time, he was still the seventh prince who had no experience in the world. His mother, Concubine Jing, was a medical woman in the Lin Mansion. She had a gentle and forbearing temperament and gave him the purest upbringing. He grew up next to the emperor's eldest brother, King Qi Xiao Jingyu, and was deeply influenced by King Qi's wise character. The seeds of justice and responsibility were planted in his heart early. The most dazzling light in his life came from his cousin and best friend, Lin Shu, the marshal of the Red Flame Army. At that time, Lin Shu was the brightest young man in Jinling City, with bright clothes and angry horses, strong martial arts skills, and a youthful spirit in his brows; Xiao Yan was brave and upright, with a stubborn and pure temperament. The two of them stayed together day and night, practicing swordplay in the martial arts field, reading together in the study, and making a vow together to "ride the horse and whip the mountain to protect the rivers and mountains of Daliang."
The friendship of young people is pure and passionate; the ideal of young people is magnanimous and firm. At that time, Xiao Yan had already distinguished himself in the military. He inherited the fortitude of General Lin Xie and the calm demeanor of a prince. He gradually gained prestige in the Red Flame Army. He fought side by side with Lin Shu and was invincible. He remembered that Lin Shu once patted him on the shoulder and said, "Jingyan, in the future I will guard the border, and you will assist Mingjun. Together we will make the country of Daliang peaceful and peaceful, and there will no longer be war and displacement." He also remembered that he had solemnly promised to protect Lin Shu, the Red Flame Army, and the thousands of miles of rivers and mountains in this Daliang. At that time, they thought the road ahead was open and that their vows could be expected, but they didn't know that a well-planned conspiracy had been quietly brewing in the dark and was about to tear all this beauty into pieces.
Twelve years ago, the Red Flame Army was ordered to go to Meiling to resist the invasion of the Chongqing Emperor's army. The 70,000 Chiyaners, all loyal and brave men, fought bloody battles under the leadership of General Lin Xie. Although they suffered heavy casualties, they eventually defeated the enemy. But just when they thought they could make a triumphant return, Xie Yu and Xia Jiang arrived with a hundred thousand troops from the Western Region. They used a counterfeit letter from Nie Feng asking for help as an excuse to slander King Qi for treason and the Red Flame Army's rebellion. Liang Emperor Xiao Xuan was already wary of the prestige of King Qi and the strength of the Red Flame Army, and under the slanderous words of Xie Yu and Xia Jiang, he issued an imperial edict to massacre all 70,000 Red Flame loyal men in Meiling. Fire burned through the tents, and the blood stained the streams. The once invincible Red Flame Army became rebellious officials and traitors; the former gentle and wise King Qi was sentenced to death in the palace, and Prince Qi's Mansion and Commander Chi Yan's Mansion were confiscated.
At that time, Xiao Yan was on an imperial mission to the East China Sea. Before leaving, he promised Lin Shu that he would bring back pearls as big as pigeon eggs for him. But when he returned, Jinling City had changed. There was no news of his former close friends, his respected eldest brother died unjustly, and the loyal soldiers, burdened with eternal infamy, were buried in the wilderness of Meiling. At that moment, Xiao Yan's world completely collapsed. He didn't believe that his eldest brother, who cared about his family and country, would rebel, he didn't believe that the Red Flames who fought alongside him would rebel, and he didn't believe that his most trusted father would be so ruthless and kill Zhongliang.
Above the court, everyone in the civil and military dynasties tried to avoid him. No one dared to speak a word of justice for King Qi and the Red Flame Army. Only Xiao Yan, regardless of Emperor Liang's anger and neglect, repeatedly spoke out and gave advice to the emperor.The unjust dead cry out for justice. He knelt on the Golden Palace and spoke with sonorous words, proving the innocence of King Qi and the Red Flame Army. Even though Emperor Liang Longyan was furious and reprimanded him, even if hundreds of officials criticized him and regarded him as an alien, he never wavered. "My brother is willing to guarantee with his life. Brother Qi Wang and Lin Shuai are loyal. All the Red Flame Army are loyal and brave, and they will never conspire against anything!" He said this sentence countless times, and every time, it was with heartbreaking pain. Every time, it showed his stubbornness and sincerity.
But the jealous Emperor Liang, who had supreme imperial power, would not believe his excuse after all. Since then, Xiao Yan has become a marginalized person in the court, an exiled prince. Although he had numerous military exploits, quelling border wars and appeasing the people, he never received the rewards he deserved, and he even had very few opportunities to meet Emperor Liang. Both the Crown Prince and Prince Yu wanted to win over this prince who held military power and was quite prestigious in the army, promising high officials and generous salaries, but Xiao Yan dismissed them. He hates the intrigues in the court, hates those villains who do anything for power, and he is even more unwilling to be complicit in the conspiracy to frame Chi Yan Zhongliang.
For twelve years, Xiao Yan was ordered to fight everywhere, far away from the center of power in Jinling, and traveled along the ancient border roads. Some of those ancient roads are overgrown with grass and inaccessible; some are filled with flames and smoke. He once guarded the border in the wind and snow to resist the invasion of foreign enemies; he once trudged on the muddy ancient road to comfort the displaced people; he once expressed his endless longing and unwillingness to Lin Shu's old sword in the camp late at night. He always wears a jade pendant made by the Red Flame Army, which was a gift given to him by Lin Shu back then. It is also a reminder of his loyalty to the Red Flame Army. He always keeps Lin Shu's old sword by his side and does not allow others to touch it. That sword carries the oath they made when they were young, and also carries the grievances of the 70,000 Red Flame Army.
Some people say that he is stupid, disregarding the honor of the prince, and insists on working for a group of "treasonous" people; some say that he is stubborn, knowing that the road ahead is difficult, but still walking into darkness; but only Xiao Yan knows that what he sticks to is never an empty oath, but the justice in his heart, the friendship for his best friend, the respect for loyalty, and the responsibility for his family and country. He knew that as long as he didn't give up, as long as he persisted, one day, the truth would be revealed to the world, one day, the seventy thousand loyal souls of Red Flame would be revealed, and one day, the court of Daliang would be able to return to the Qingming Dynasty.
For twelve years, he endured loneliness and pain, misunderstanding and rejection, walked alone on the lonely ancient road, and tempered himself on the iron-blooded battlefield. His edges and corners have never been smoothed by time; his sincerity has never been corroded by power. He is still the upright, stubborn, affectionate and righteous Xiao Yan, but between his brows, there is a bit more vicissitudes and perseverance, a bit more forbearance and responsibility. He accumulated strength at the border, sympathized with the soldiers, appeased the people, gained the support of the soldiers and civilians at the bottom, and also cultivated a group of loyal subordinates. The dormancy of these years is not to retreat or compromise, but to wait for an opportunity, an opportunity to clear up the evil for the Red Flame Army and eliminate traitors for the family and the country.
Finally, that opportunity came. Twelve years later, a counselor named Mei Changsu came to Jinling City with his sick body. In the name of "Qilin Talent", he stirred up the situation in Jinling. He seemed to be dealing with the relationship between the crown prince and Prince Yu, but in fact, he had already chosen Xiao Yan and was determined to assist him in ascending to the throne of God and vindicate the injustice of the Red Flame Army. When Mei Changsu appeared in front of Xiao Yan for the first time, Xiao Yan did not recognize his identity. He only thought that this counselor was gentle, yet thoughtful and sharp, no different from the Machiavellian man he hated.
At first, Xiao Yan was wary and misunderstood Mei Changsu. He resented Mei Changsu's use of Machiavellian tactics and his dealing with the whirlpool of power. Even when Princess Nihuang was framed by Concubine Yue, he angrily rebuked Mei Changsu, not allowing him to challenge his bottom line or use Machiavellian tactics to frame him.Zhongliang. He told Mei Changsu: "What I, Xiao Jamyan, seek has never been the throne, but to vindicate Brother Qi Wang and the Red Flame Army, and to seek the welfare of the people of the world. If you are just for power and profit, then we have different ways and will not conspire against each other."
Mei Changsu never defended himself, but just stayed by Xiao Yan's side silently, advising him and clearing obstacles on his way to the throne. During the land invasion case, Mei Changsu planned for him and helped him stand out in the court, arousing the vigilance of the prince and Prince Yu. When Ting Sheng was imprisoned, Mei Changsu used a clever plan to help him rescue Prince Qi's posthumous son, ending his years of trouble. Wish: During the Jiu'an Mountain Incident, Mei Changsu helped him obtain the military talisman and put down King Yu's rebellion. However, after Xiao Yan put down the rebellion, he immediately returned the military talisman to Emperor Liang. His magnanimity and integrity made even Emperor Liang hesitate.
In getting along again and again, Xiao Yan gradually discovered that there were too many familiar traces on Mei Changsu. His small movements of rubbing his fingers and twisting his sleeves when thinking, his concern for the Red Flame Army, and his familiarity with the old events in Jinling all reminded Xiao Yan of Lin Shu back then. But he couldn't believe that the sickly and incompetent counselor could be the young Marshal Chi Yan who wore bright clothes and raged horses, but also had great martial arts skills. He was afraid that his guess was true, afraid of the suffering Lin Shu had suffered over the years, and even more afraid that his personal emotions would affect the cause of clearing up the unjust case.
The Wei Zheng incident became a turning point in the relationship between the two, and also a turning point in Xiao Yan's state of mind. Taking advantage of Xiao Yan's concern for Chi Yan's old men, Xia Jiang set a trap, kidnapped Wei Zheng, and tempted Xiao Yan to act impulsively in an attempt to bring him down completely. After Xiao Yan learned that Wei Zheng had been kidnapped, he was furious. He mistakenly believed that Mei Changsu was sacrificing Chi Yan's old men in order to seize the heirloom's great cause. He cut off the palace bell that represented mutual trust with a sword, and angrily accused Mei Changsu of "having no nature and conscience", completely ignoring the pleas of Mei Changsu, who was seriously ill. At that moment, Xiao Yan's heartache was not only because of the misunderstanding, but also because he was afraid that the belief he had held on to for twelve years would be completely shattered by the machinations.
It was not until the truth gradually emerged that Xiao Yan finally learned that the sickly counselor in front of him was his best friend Lin Shu, who he had missed for twelve years. When Meng Zhi informed him of Mei Changsu's true identity, this iron-clad man could no longer suppress the emotions in his heart. He returned to Zhiluo Palace, knelt down at Concubine Jing's knees, and cried bitterly: "Mother, I almost recognized him, I should have recognized him... He is Xiao Shu, he is my Xiao Shu..."
At that moment, all the misunderstandings and suspicions, all the loneliness and pain, turned into tears. He finally understood that what Mei Changsu had endured over the years was more than him; what Mei Changsu had to bear was heavier than him. With a frail body, Mei Changsu was burdened with the grievances of the 70,000 Red Flame Army, and he circled in the whirlpool of power, step by step, just to show his loyalty to his soul, just to assist him in ascending to the throne, and just to fulfill the oath they made when they were young. But I misunderstood him time and time again, hurt him, and even almost ruined all hope.
After learning the truth, Xiao Yan did not indulge in sadness and guilt, but turned all his emotions into the strength to move forward. He no longer rejects machinations and is no longer stubborn. Instead, he learns to be tolerant and adaptable, learns to stick to the bottom line in the whirlpool of machinations, and learns to fight side by side with Mei Changsu to jointly advance the great cause of Zhaoxue. He knew that only by ascending to the throne and gaining power could they truly bring justice to the Red Flame Army, eradicate the traitors, and truly realize their youthful ideals.
After that, Xiao Yan and Mei Changsu planned closely and worked step by step. They joined forces with Yan Que, Meng Zhi, Ni Huang and other loyal people to collect evidence that Xie Yu and Xia Jiang framed the Red Flame Army; they took advantage of the conflict between the prince and King Yu to reap profits and gradually strengthen their own power; they fought openly and secretly in the court, thwarted the plots of traitors time and time again, and shaken the rule of Emperor Liang little by little.. Xiao Yan is no longer the stubborn prince who can only speak out and give advice. He has become calm, wise and responsible. He can not only strategize on the battlefield and win thousands of miles, but also judge the situation in the court and plan every step.
At the birthday banquet of Emperor Liang, the eldest princess of Liyang brought Xie Yu's handwritten confession and revealed a corner of Chi Yan's unjust case in public. At that moment, the court was shaken and all the officials were in an uproar. Xiao Yan stepped forward and presented all the evidence to prove the innocence of King Qi and the Red Flame Army. Every word was bloody and every sentence was sonorous. He had a fierce confrontation with Emperor Liang, asking Emperor Liang why he wanted to slaughter Zhongliang, why he betrayed his country and the people, and why he let 70,000 red flame loyal souls live in injustice.
"Father, twelve years ago, on the Meiling Mountains, 70,000 Red Flames fought bloody battles to guard the border for Daliang, but what they got in exchange was arrows piercing their hearts and their bodies burned in flames. Brother Qi Wang was wise and capable, and he cared about his family and country, but what he got in exchange was a cup of In the past twelve years, I have traveled along the ancient border roads and seen too many displaced people and too many injustices suffered by Chiyan’s old tribe. I have only one wish in my heart, which is to bring justice to them! "
After all, Emperor Liang's anger could not withstand the ironclad evidence, the people's will, and Xiao Yan's persistence and perseverance. In the end, Emperor Liang was forced to issue an order to retry Chi Yan's old case, so that King Qi, Lin Xie and the 70,000 Chi Yan army could be vindicated. Xie Yu, Xia Jiang and other traitors were finally brought to justice and received the punishment they deserved. When the imperial edict was read out, the wind in Meiling seemed to become gentler; the warm sun in Jinling City seemed to become brighter. Twelve years of forbearance and perseverance, twelve years of loneliness and pain, finally brought justice and the rest of the loyal soul.
Soon after, Emperor Liang ascended the throne, Xiao Yan ascended the throne as emperor, changed his name to Wu Jing, and was known as Emperor Wu Jing in history. After ascending the throne, Xiao Yan did not indulge in the honor of the throne. Instead, he fulfilled his oath and devoted himself to rectifying the imperial court, appeasing the people, and revitalizing the Daliang River and Mountains. He reused Yan Que, Shen Zhui, Cai Quan and other virtuous people to rectify the government and severely punish corruption; he promoted benevolent government, reduced taxes, appeased the displaced people, and made Daliang's national power stronger and stronger; he carried out military reforms, eliminated the old and weak, reorganized the northern border army into the Changlin Army, and appointed Wei Zheng to train the navy, making Daliang's border defense more stable.
He has never forgotten the 70,000 loyal souls of Meiling, nor those who sacrificed their lives for justice. He personally went to Meiling to pay homage to the officers and soldiers of the Red Flame Army, and erected monuments and inscriptions on the ancient roads to remember their loyalty, bravery and injustice; he named King Qi the Emperor Jingheng, Lin Xie the King Zhongwu, and all the officers and soldiers of the Red Flame Army the Marquis of Zhongyong, so that their loyal names would forever be recorded in the annals of history. He often came to the ancient road of Meiling alone and stroked the stone tablets. He seemed to still be able to see the bloody battle of the Red Flame Army, and he seemed to still be able to hear Lin Shu's laughter when he was a boy.
After all, Mei Changsu could not accompany him to the end. After pacifying the war in the north, Mei Changsu dragged his sick body back to Meiling. He eventually died of illness at the place where the Red Flame Army fought bloody battles. He completed his mission and fulfilled the oath he and Xiao Yan made. After Xiao Yan heard the news, he was devastated, but he did not indulge in sadness. He knew that he could not fall. With Mei Changsu's wish and the expectation of 70,000 Red Flame loyal souls, he would protect the mountains and rivers of this beam, govern the world well, let the people live and work in peace and contentment, and let there be no more injustice and war.
Xiao Yan's life was a life of ups and downs, a life of forbearance, and a life of loyalty. He was born in a palace wall, but he was not tainted by the turmoil of power and conspiracy; he was trapped in the mud, but his heart was always towards the light; he was burdened with blood feud, but he always adhered to the bottom line. He walked alone on the lonely ancient road for twelve years, using his sword as an oath and his heart as a torch to open a path to justice; he stuck to his original intention in the whirlpool of power, took loyalty as his soul and righteousness as his bones, and paid tribute to the grievances of 70,000 red flame loyal souls.The ancient road hides the loyal bones, which are the loyal souls of the 70,000 Red Flame Army, the loyal souls of King Qi, and the loyal souls of all those who sacrificed for justice; sacrificing the heroic souls under the sword is Xiao Yan's life-long persistence and responsibility to protect his loyal soul and protect his family and country. Xiao Yan used his life to explain what loyalty is, what responsibility is, and what an innocent heart is. His story, like the wind in Meiling, has traveled through thousands of years and still echoes on the ancient roads; his loyalty, like an immortal monument, stands among the mountains and rivers of Daliang and will last forever.
Many years later, when someone walks on the ancient road in Meiling, looking at the stone tablet engraved with loyal names, and listening to the old man telling the story of the past, he will always think of that heroic, upright, stubborn and sincere prince, and of his life of sacrificing his heroic spirit with his sword and guarding his country with his heart. Xiao Yan's name has long been integrated with the loyal soul of Red Flame and the rivers and mountains of Daliang. It has become a legend of loyalty that has been passed down through the ages and will always be remembered by the world.
